title: Maintenance queue by priority
description: For jobs with status = pending, return exactly four columns: job_id, database_name, priority, priority_rank. Compute priority_rank as 1 for critical, 2 for high, 3 for normal, and 4 for every other value. Sort by priority_rank ASC, scheduled_seq ASC, then job_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT job_id, database_name, priority
FROM maintenance_jobs
hints: CASE is useful for turning textual priority into a numeric order.
scheduled_seq participates in sorting but does not have to be an output column.
solution_explanation: An explicit priority_rank makes queue ordering independent from alphabetical text ordering.
